title: Adobe / LibRaw Nikon Z 8 calibration-matrix reference

source.attribution: LibRaw attributes these matrices to Adobe DNG Converter unless otherwise noted; the Nikon Z 8 entry has no exception.

matrix_direction: CIE XYZ to reference camera native RGB
derivation: Invert the matrix to camera RGB -> XYZ; normalize each inverse-matrix column by X+Y+Z to obtain its xy basis coordinate.
scope: Single published matrix; no dual-illuminant interpolation, individual-camera calibration match, or added chromatic adaptation. No 4000 K assignment. D65 in the figure labels the three encoding spaces only.
interpretation: Virtual matrix basis coordinates for reference, not a measured sensor gamut or recordable-colour boundary.
